import sys,json,re,concurrent.futures
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp')
from g6_metadata import fetch,OUT,EXTRAS
p=OUT/'pypi-metadata.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text());nodes=d['nodes']
d['priorMetadataFailures']=[v for v in nodes.values() if v['status']=='NOT_VERIFIED']
pending={'aiohttp':'3.14.4','pydantic-core':'2.50.2','lxml':'6.1.3','rpds-py':'2026.9.1','httpx':'0.28.1','pycparser':'3.12'}
for iteration in range(5):
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
  values=list(pool.map(fetch,pending.items()))
 for name,val in zip(pending,values):nodes[name]=val
 pending={};edges=[];excluded=[]
 for name,node in nodes.items():
  for req in node.get('requiresDist',[]):
   extras=re.findall(r'extra\s*==\s*[\"\x27]([^\"\x27]+)',req)
   if extras and not set(extras)&EXTRAS.get(name,set()):excluded.append({'from':name,'requirement':req,'reason':'UNSELECTED_EXTRA'});continue
   m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)(?:\[([^]]+)\])?',req)
   if not m:edges.append({'from':name,'requirement':req,'status':'UNPARSED_BLOCKER'});continue
   dep=re.sub(r'[-_.]+','-',m[1]).lower()
   edges.append({'from':name,'to':dep,'requirement':req,'status':'CONSTRAINT_AND_PLATFORM_NOT_RESOLVED'})
   if dep not in nodes:pending[dep]=None
 print(json.dumps({'nodes':len(nodes),'pending':list(pending)}),flush=True)
 if not pending:break
 if len(nodes)+len(pending)>140:break
 d['edges']=edges
# all declarations are retained; selection and version solving explicitly unverified
for key in ['additionalDeclaredRequirements']:d.pop(key,None)
d.update(edges=edges,excludedExtras=excluded,unfetched=sorted(pending))
d['metadataFailures']=[n for n,v in nodes.items() if v['status']=='NOT_VERIFIED']
d['methodNotes']=['Initial package-wide metadata responses exceeding 4MiB refused. Exact release URLs used for bounded follow-up; prior failures retained.','aiohttp 3.14.4 is an observed explicit release, not asserted latest.','No package/weight downloads, installs, constraint solver or vulnerability audit. Empty PyPI advisory list is not a security PASS.','Transitive extras and target markers still require per-platform solver and approved installation stage.']
p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'nodes':len(nodes),'edges':len(edges),'unfetched':d['unfetched'],'failures':d['metadataFailures']}))

import sys,json,re,urllib.request,datetime,concurrent.futures
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp')
from g6_metadata import fetch,OUT
p=OUT/'pypi-metadata.json';d=json.loads(p.read_text());nodes=d['nodes'];history=d.setdefault('priorMetadataFailures',[])
extras={k:set(v) for k,v in d['selectedExtras'].items()};extras['docling-slim'].add('models-local')
# Full docling standard graph is enumerated for comparison; minimal slim is preferred later.
extras['docling-slim'].add('standard')
for iteration in range(8):
 edges=[];excluded=[];pending={};changed=False
 for name,node in list(nodes.items()):
  for req in node.get('requiresDist',[]):
   gates=re.findall(r'extra\s*==\s*[\"\x27]([^\"\x27]+)',req)
   if gates and not set(gates)&extras.get(name,set()):excluded.append({'from':name,'requirement':req,'reason':'UNSELECTED_EXTRA'});continue
   m=re.match(r'([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)(?:\[([^]]+)\])?',req)
   if not m:edges.append({'from':name,'requirement':req,'status':'UNPARSED_BLOCKER'});continue
   dep=re.sub(r'[-_.]+','-',m[1]).lower()
   selected=set(m[2].split(',')) if m[2] else set()
   before=set(extras.get(dep,set()));extras.setdefault(dep,set()).update(selected)
   changed |= before!=extras[dep]
   edges.append({'from':name,'to':dep,'requirement':req,'status':'CONSTRAINT_AND_PLATFORM_NOT_RESOLVED'})
   if dep not in nodes:pending[dep]=None
 for name in ['multidict','yarl']:
  if nodes.get(name,{}).get('status')=='NOT_VERIFIED':pending[name]={'multidict':'7.2.1','yarl':'1.25.1'}[name]
 if len(nodes)+len(pending)>200:break
 if pending:
  with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:results=list(pool.map(fetch,pending.items()))
  for (name,_),node in zip(pending.items(),results):
   if nodes.get(name,{}).get('status')=='NOT_VERIFIED':history.append(nodes[name])
   nodes[name]=node
 print(json.dumps({'round':iteration,'nodes':len(nodes),'new':len(pending),'extrasChanged':changed}),flush=True)
 if not pending and not changed:break
# Bound failures caused by all-release records: decode only info, then exact-version endpoint.
for name,node in list(nodes.items()):
 if node['status']!='NOT_VERIFIED':continue
 history.append(node)
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen('https://pypi.org/pypi/'+name+'/json',timeout=20) as r:raw=r.read(4*1024*1024)
  txt=raw.decode('utf-8');start=txt.index('"info":')+7
  info,_=json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(txt[start:].lstrip())
  nodes[name]=fetch((name,info['version']))
 except Exception as e:node['boundedRetryClass']=type(e).__name__
d.update(edges=edges,excludedExtras=excluded,selectedExtras={k:sorted(v) for k,v in extras.items() if v},unfetched=sorted({e['to'] for e in edges if 'to' in e}-nodes.keys()),metadataFailures=[n for n,v in nodes.items() if v['status']=='NOT_VERIFIED'])
d['scope']='Conservative cross-platform declared graph for docling standard and selected format/local-model extras plus Paddle OCR core; transitive named extras propagated to fixed point. All environment markers retained and not evaluated; current registry versions are observations, NOT an installation lock.'
d['methodNotes'].append('Full standard/local-model declarations added; transitive named extras propagated. Some newly recovered metadata may require another graph pass; see graph-audit.json.')
p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'nodes':len(nodes),'edges':len(edges),'failures':d['metadataFailures']}))

import urllib.request,json,hashlib,datetime
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/Users/chasen/.codex/worktrees/g6-p0-parser-prep-master/ontology-platform/experiments/g6-p0/supply-chain/model-metadata.json')
rows=[]
for repo in ['docling-project/docling-layout-heron','docling-project/docling-models','PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv5_server_det','PaddlePaddle/PP-OCRv5_server_rec']:
 url='https://huggingface.co/api/models/'+repo+'?blobs=true'
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=20) as f:raw=f.read(1024*1024+1)
  if len(raw)>1024*1024:raise ValueError('bounded')
  d=json.loads(raw)
  rows.append({'repo':repo,'source':url,'observedRevision':d.get('sha'),'licenseDeclared':d.get('cardData',{}).get('license'),'gated':d.get('gated'),'rawMetadataSha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'files':[{'path':f['rfilename'],'size':f.get('size'),'gitBlobId':f.get('blobId'),'lfs':f.get('lfs')} for f in d.get('siblings',[])],'status':'METADATA_ONLY_NOT_DOWNLOAD_APPROVED'})
 except Exception as e:rows.append({'repo':repo,'source':url,'status':'NOT_VERIFIED','errorClass':type(e).__name__})
out.write_text(json.dumps({'taskId':'G6-P0-PARSER-PREP-001','utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'weightDownloads':0,'rows':rows,'limitation':'Candidate model repositories only; not asserted exhaustive runtime dependency set. File hashes are registry claims, no local payload validation. All download/execution remains BLOCKED_PENDING_AUTHORIZATION.'},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps([{'repo':r['repo'],'status':r['status'],'files':len(r.get('files',[]))} for r in rows]))
